deepDives.nicht_0_und_1_gleichzeitig: Not “0 and 1 at the same time”, but amplitudes that can cancel each other out. From the Bloch sphere through interference and entanglement to Grover — all of it computed live.
deepDives.warum_die_blaue_led_dreissig: Why the blue LED took thirty years
deepDives.rot_leuchtete_1962_fuer_blau: Red lit up in 1962; blue took three more decades. From the band gap through the buffer layer to the quantum well, step by step and hands-on.
deepDives.ein_bit_auf_einem_kondensator: A bit on a capacitor that drains all by itself. From the DRAM cell through the row buffer to Rowhammer — where reading alters the row next door.
deepDives.flashzellen_nandbloecke_und_die_adressue: Flash cells, NAND blocks and the address translation in between — plus a calculated access comparison: SSD versus HDD.
